definition.label: Fixed V25 with orthogonalized item-history support
definition.formula: Keep the original V25 head beta0 fixed. On identical6k correction rows fit signedlog standardization for U; missing values are0 in centered basis with explicit shared support flags. Fit A=lstsq(Xbase,U,rcond=1e-6); R=U-Xbase*A. Do not rescale residuals. eta0=logit(frozenKumo)+.5*Xbase*beta0. Fit gamma minimizing meanBCE(eta0+R*gamma)+.01/2||gamma||^2. Inference eta=eta0+.25*R*gamma; final=.75sigmoid(eta)+.25original_spline77; mean5fold test. Projection is training-only; query targets are unused.
definition.rationale: V243 shared coverage-only augmentation lowered KS to0.52934705 and AUC to0.84692008, although counts have strong marginal risk associations. V25 already includes observation depth and posterior uncertainty. Preserve its learned correction; test residual information without refitting its90 coefficients. V251 is the matched support control, V252 adds value information, V253 diagnoses the projection choice. Coefficients use the same6k as the original head, so training optimism and repeated development selection remain; no improvement is assumed.

definition.formula: Preserve corrected Kumo and cached original spline. Fit standalone logistic GAM on identical56k outer-training rows, signedlog, median fill, quadratic3-knot quantile splines on continuous inputs, linear discrete inputs, explicit missing/categorical terms; meanBCE+.01/2||beta||^2 via C=1/(56000*.01), intercept unpenalized. No group-specific effects. Final=.95p_V25+.05p_newGAM; p_V25=.75p_correctedKumo+.25p_originalSpline. Fixed5% new contribution, no outer weight/route selection; mean5foldtest.
definition.rationale: Peer ALL66 obtained exploratory0.53401 but cross-fitted selection0.530402 and public0.55983. Its broad spline/population work motivates testing the secondary branch under a fixed small contribution, not copying selected routing/global-prevalence shifts. Our current18-input correction sees only6k labels; a separate latent spline can use all56k while keeping the Kumo branch exact.
